subject: M032 indirect-control designation flow, autonomous detailed-region work selection, movement, logistics, needs interruption, and evidence quality
acceptanceCriteria: Extraction and storage are designated through the supported graphical input path without direct worker assignment.
Two generic workers autonomously choose distinct valid work and their choices are understandable.
Movement, carried resources, interactions, needs, and blocked/replan states are visually readable.
Temporary blockage causes coherent replan rather than teleportation or silent stall.
Mandatory need interruption occurs at a sensible semantic boundary and is explained.
Designation changes recover without duplicate work.
Save/load while carrying continues coherently and structural evidence proves conservation.
Route and decision debug projections are useful.
The slice feels autonomous rather than scripted.
Evidence separates semantic authority from graphical review and deferred work.
waiverPolicy: No implicit waiver. A waiver is acceptable only if the pending request is explicitly amended before review and the record states the bounded reason.
